description:
Output contract for POST /v1/embed.

`model_id` and `revision` say which pinned model produced the vectors; the caller
compares them with what it expects on every response and refuses a mismatch.
Carries no text.

revision.description: Pinned revision: a full commit for a hub model, a label for a directory
revision.title: Revision

vectors.description: One unit-length vector per text, in order
vectors.title: Vectors
